themes.title: Electoral Volatility and Internal Friction Facing Right-Wing Parties
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist parties across Europe and the US are encountering heightened political resistance, internal strategic disagreements, and voter pushback. From Sweden Democrats suffering polling dips to Rassemblement National debating Ukraine aid and MAGA allies questioning executive decisions, right-wing movements face internal and external strains.

countries.note: Grappling with internal party friction over Ukraine aid funding and structural economic policy hurdles that deter moderate voters

themes.title: Trump's 'America First' Global Repercussions
themes.blurb: Unilateral US foreign policy initiatives, defense pacts, and hardline enforcement frameworks are sending shockwaves through international politics. Foreign governments and European right-wing parties are recalibrating their stances in response to sweeping sanctions, major arms deals, and aggressive immigration enforcement playbooks.

themes.title: Challenges to Established Institutions and Norms
themes.blurb: Populist leaders and parties continue to test institutional boundaries, confronting press organizations, central banks, regional governing bodies, and longstanding norms.
